change: Classify native command-buffer OOM as Error::OutOfMemory only when NSError domain equals exported MTLCommandBufferErrorDomain and code is 8; other non-loss failures remain Internal; loss codes are now domain-checked too

gates.classification: OOM code8/domain, unknown and foreign-domain codes
gates.routing: OOM scope capture and pop return; foreign-domain code8 bypasses OOM scope to original Internal handler; reentry, owner isolation and no duplicates

limits: Synthetic completion failures on real Metal adapter, no physical OOM pressure or device removal
Actual NSError extraction is compiled/linked but forced native NSError completion is not covered
Other native command failure codes remain Internal
No idle notifications or performance/platform qualification
